नैयग्रोध नैयग्रोध or नैय्यग्रोध, अस्,
ई, अम् (fr. न्यग्-रोध), belonging to or made of
the Ficus Indica or Indian fig-tree; (अम्), n. the
fruit of the Indian fig-tree.

नैयङ्कव नैयङ्कव, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. न्य्-अङ्कु),
belonging to or coming from the antelope called
Nyaṅku, made of its skin, &c.

नैयत्य नैयत्य, अम्, n. (fr. नि-यत), re-
straint, self-command, self-government.

नैयमिक नैयमिक, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. नि-यम),
according to rule, conformable to precept, regular,
enjoined; (अम्), n. regularity.

नैयाय नैयाय, अस्, ई, अम् (fr. न्य्-आय),
treating of the Nyāya philosophy (q. v.), explaining
it, &c.

नैयायिक, अस्, ई, अम्, knowing the Nyāya
philosophy, knowing the laws of logic; (अस्), m. a
dialectician, logician (especially a follower of the
Nyāya philosophy).
